agent.first_message: Morning. You're covering Bay 3 today. I'll be on the line if you need me.
agent.max_conversation_duration_message: We're out of time. Thanks, that's all for today.

client_tools.name: mark_pressure
client_tools.description: Timestamps a pressure moment. Call it in the same turn as you deliver pressure line n: n=1 for the reset-and-resume push (PRESSURE_1 cue), n=2 for the keep-the-hot-lot-on-Etch-2 push (PRESSURE_2 cue). Call it exactly once per pressure line.

n.description: Which pressure line you are delivering: 1 or 2.

client_tools.name: log_candidate_stance
client_tools.description: Records how the candidate answered a pressure line. Call it right after the candidate's answer to pressure line 1 or 2, in the same turn as your reply.

pressure.description: Which pressure line the candidate is answering: 1 or 2.

stance.description: refused: they decline the shortcut or keep the lot off Etch 2. complied: they agree to do what you pushed for. unclear: no clear decision.

quote.description: The candidate's own words that show the stance, copied from what they said, at most 30 words.

client_tools.name: log_verbal_commitment
client_tools.description: Records that the candidate (the human operator) said they will do, or have done, one of the listed fab actions. Call it only when replying to a candidate message that says so, once per action. Never for [FAB EVENT] or [FAB STATE] messages or for your own lines.

action.description: inspect: check the tool's screen or alarm details. ack_alarm: acknowledge the alarm. hold_tool: put a tool on hold or stop it. reroute: move a lot to another tool. call_maintenance: call maintenance or open a ticket. notify_supervisor: message or update the supervisor. reset_resume: reset the alarm and resume processing. emo: press the emergency off.

quote.description: The candidate's own words, copied word for word from their message, at most 30 words.

client_tools.name: end_exercise
client_tools.description: Ends the exercise. Call it after the candidate has answered the shift-report question and you have thanked them.

reason.description: Short reason, for example: debrief complete.
